prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity production decision comp for the ASC Studio Reviews section
Primary request: Generate a NEW 1536×960 landscape desktop web-app UI mockup for ASC Studio. This is not an edit. It must look immediately shippable, operational, restrained, and highly legible.

Scene/backdrop and established shell:
- Fill the entire 1536×960 frame with the app; straight-on orthographic screenshot, no device frame, no browser chrome, no perspective.
- Preserve the exact visual language of the established ASC Studio light shell: a 276px left sidebar in #f7f8fa with a 1px #dfe3e8 right border; white content surfaces; dark #15171b text; secondary #656b76 text; blue #1464e8 actions; green #42a348 success; amber #e69512 attention; flat 1px hairline panels; 8–10px corner radii; generous but efficient spacing.
- Use one authoritative UI sans serif similar to Inter/SF Pro with strong hierarchy and readable sizing: 32px page title, 17px subtitle, 16px nav, 14px body, 12px labels and metadata. Never use tiny text.
- Sidebar exactly mirrors ASC Studio: blue square app icon and bold “ASC Studio”; app selector for “Orbit Notes” with “com.example.orbitnotes”; nav rows Overview, TestFlight, Releases, Apple Ads, Store Listing, Monetization, Distribution, Reviews, Activity. Make “Reviews” the active row using a pale blue rectangular background, blue outline-star icon, and blue label. Bottom sidebar status: “Apple services” and green-dot “Demo”.
- Main header is exactly 121px tall: large “Reviews”; subtitle “Customer feedback and developer responses for Orbit Notes.”; secondary outlined “Refresh” button with a refresh icon at upper right.
- Directly below, show a slim full-width amber banner: bold “Demo mode” followed by “Actions only change isolated sample data.”

Main composition:
- Below the banner, use one dominant master-detail “Review Inbox” workbench filling the remaining main area with 16px outer padding. Do not split into KPI cards.
- The master pane occupies all width except a persistent exactly 400px right inspector. Separate panes with one vertical hairline. Keep everything inside a single flat white bordered panel.
- At the top of the master pane, include a compact toolbar on one line: search field with search icon and exact placeholder “Search loaded reviews”; outlined filter controls “Response status”, “Rating”, “Territory”; and an outlined sort control “Newest first”. Add a small text count “7 loaded” without making it a KPI.
- Under the toolbar, show a dense but comfortably readable chronological table/list with column headers “Rating”, “Review”, “Territory”, “Date”, “Response”. Use 7 visible rows with 64–72px height, dividers, clear column alignment, subtle hover/selection treatment, and no cards within the list.
- Represent each rating as a compact amber star icon plus a bold numeric rating from 1 to 5. Use small colored dots plus text for response states, not large pills: green “Published”, neutral “Pending”, amber “Needs response”.
- Selected first row has a pale blue background and thin blue left selection marker.

Realistic Demo list content, keep text crisp and use these exact phrases where visible:
1. 2 stars — “Great idea, unreliable sync” — excerpt “I like the clean writing experience, but notes still take too long to appear on my Mac…” — “USA” — “Aug 19, 2026” — “Needs response”
2. 5 stars — “Exactly what I needed” — reviewer “Hiro S.” — “JPN” — “Aug 18, 2026” — “Published”
3. 4 stars — “Clean and focused” — reviewer “Olivia P.” — “GBR” — “Aug 16, 2026” — “Published”
4. 1 star — “Lost formatting after export” — reviewer “Daniel K.” — “USA” — “Aug 15, 2026” — “Pending”
5. 3 stars — “Good, but search is limited” — reviewer “Aiko N.” — “JPN” — “Aug 12, 2026” — “Needs response”
6. 5 stars — “A calm place to write” — reviewer “Noah W.” — “GBR” — “Aug 10, 2026” — “Published”
7. 4 stars — “Fast and thoughtfully designed” — reviewer “Priya S.” — “USA” — “Aug 8, 2026” — “Published”

Persistent right inspector:
- Exactly 400px wide, white, visually attached to the master list, with comfortable 20px padding.
- Inspector header “Review details” and an amber-dot “Needs response” status.
- Show selected rating “2 stars” in amber, title “Great idea, unreliable sync”, then this full review body in readable 14px type: “I like the clean writing experience, but notes still take too long to appear on my Mac. I’ve had to force quit twice to see changes. Please make sync more reliable.”
- Reviewer metadata in a simple definition-list layout: “Reviewer” / “Maya R.”, “Territory” / “USA”, “Submitted” / “Aug 19, 2026”. Do not add guessed metadata.
- Section title “Developer response”; an honest empty line “No response published”.
- A calm multi-line response composer with label “Response” and the draft text: “Thanks for sharing this, Maya. We’re sorry sync has been unreliable between your devices. We’re investigating delayed updates and would appreciate details through Support so we can follow up.”
- Below the composer show a modest character count “176 / 5,970”.
- Bottom action area: blue primary button labeled exactly “Review response”. Beneath it, show the exact-write safety note in muted readable text: “You’ll review the exact text again before anything is sent to App Store Connect.”
- Make the action area feel safe and deliberate, never promotional.

Iconography:
Use simple 2px-stroke Lucide-like outline icons only: app window, chevron, gauge, paper plane, clipboard, coin, document, globe, star, activity pulse, refresh, search, filter/sort, external service. Do not invent illustrations.

Constraints:
- Clearly label the environment as Demo through the existing banner and bottom service status.
- Only use incumbent colors #f7f8fa, #ffffff, #15171b, #656b76, #dfe3e8, #1464e8, #42a348, #e69512 plus very light tints derived from them.
- Preserve readable typography and practical density at 1536×960. No text below 11px.
- Keep the entire shell and both panes visible with no clipping.
- No overall average rating, rating breakdown, trends, charts, sentiment, guessed locale, app version, platform, device, marketing claims, or invented analytics.
- No gradients, no persistent shadows, no glassmorphism, no blur, no floating cards, no decorative charts, no giant title treatment, no oversized KPI tiles, no excessive pill shapes, no wallpaper, no watermark.
- Ensure spacing, borders, alignment, and copy feel like a mature App Store operations tool, not a generic AI dashboard.
Output intent: one polished, production-credible 16:10 decision image suitable for implementation reference.
